column1: # Retrieval eval set for ILSpy. See tests/eval/README.md for the format.
# repository: https://github.com/icsharpcode/ILSpy
# revision: d29aeb3eaae54efc841cff307dca01c7218e477c
# Targets are declarations of 21-150 lines in main source, never under a
# `*.Tests/` path. `ICSharpCode.Decompiler.Tests/TestCases/` is a tree of
# synthetic decompiler fixtures whose file names match these queries by
# construction; before suffixed test directories were recognised it took 10% of
# the top-10 slots and test projects took 17%, which measured how well the
# ranker avoids a decoy rather than how well it retrieves.
# Two rows target code no adapter can see: one file is wholly inside
# `#if DEBUG`, the other inside `#if !NET8_0_OR_GREATER`, and `ast-bro map`
# reports zero declarations for both. Their spans are written by hand, which
# the symbol form could not express.
# 26% of callable names here repeat within their file, and `Instructions.cs`
# alone contributes a third of that with roughly 300 `AcceptVisitor` methods.
# Prefer a name unique in its file when extending the set.
# Rows 1-15 and 16-30 were written separately and score the same (recall@5 27%
# and 27%), which is the exception among the shipped sets rather than the rule.
# Judge a ranking change by the per-query diff, never by the summary line, and
# never by comparing this corpus's summary against another one's.
decide whether a stream holds plain text, xml or raw binary data
find and open the debug database that belongs to a loaded module
escape the special characters of a string constant so the printed source still compiles
collapse dot and dot-dot segments of a path into one canonical form
rewrite an absolute path so it is expressed from a base directory instead
group items into disjoint sets and look up which one an item belongs to
visit every reachable node of a graph exactly once by following its edges
turn a compiler-generated iterator class back into yield statements
work out where control leaves the body of a loop
recognise the shape a compiler emits when a switch is done over string values
read one opcode out of the byte stream and build the matching instruction
convert a boxed value from one numeric type to another and fail when it overflows
emit a standalone debug database alongside the decompiled output
scan method bodies for a constant value the user typed into the search box
read the resource directory tree embedded in a PE image
pick one concrete type for a generic placeholder from everything it must convert to and from
when two candidate methods both accept the same call, apply the tie-breaking rules that pick a winner
flatten the nested chain the compiler builds for a value group with more than seven members
recognise the instruction sequence emitted right before a generated method suspends itself, and cut it away
for every basic block, work out the nearest earlier block that all paths from the entry must pass through
decide whether a jump table would read better as a case statement or as a chain of if tests
find the narrowest block that encloses every use of a temporary so its declaration can go there
work out how tightly each kind of expression binds so redundant brackets can be left out
express a floating point value as the closest ratio of two whole numbers under a size limit
read one attribute parameter value out of the binary blob according to the tag that describes it
insert a byte-offset range into a tree of ranges, rejecting it when it only partly overlaps a sibling
rebuild the compact drawing-command text for a shape outline from its compiled binary form
try each registered pattern from the newest backwards until one of them rewrites the word
find the position of the lowest set bit of a machine word without a hardware instruction
dump a method's block layout to a dot file, render it with the external tool and open the picture
